summary.description: The refine report in markdown: Ask, Gaps, Files, Risks (procedure refine.md), at most 300 words.

size.description: Your size for the ticket. Used only if the ticket has none.

sizeReason.description: One line: why that size, from the files you expect to change.

tier.description: Your model tier for building it. Used only if the ticket has none.

questions.description: 1 to 5 questions for Andy, highest-impact ambiguity first.

text.description: One question, answerable without reading the code.

options.description: Choices when the answer is one of a few; empty for an open question.

suggestedAnswer.description: The answer you would pick and why in a few words, or null.

assumptions.description: What you would assume if the question went unanswered.
